name: Unsupported Operator Fallback
research_question: Does the CSP evaluator return UNKNOWN (never UNSAT) when a hop contains an unsupported operator or vendor-specific key?
complete_constraint_system: vendor:ProprietaryBiometricToken(hop1) using UnsupportedFuzzyMatch with value biometric_sample_123
formal_rationale: This fixture tests the evaluator's fallback behavior when encountering an unsupported operator (UnsupportedFuzzyMatch) on a vendor-specific key (vendor:ProprietaryBiometricToken). Per the CCPF contract section 3.1, unsupported operators must yield UNKNOWN, never UNSAT. The evaluator must not treat the unsupported constraint as a contradiction. The unknown_rationale must reference the unsupported key or operator.
falsification_criteria: The feasibility hypothesis is falsified if the evaluator outputs UNSAT (treating unsupported operator as contradiction) or SAT (incorrectly assuming the constraint is satisfied). The evaluator must return UNKNOWN with a non-empty unknown_rationale that references the unsupported key or operator.
